whyThereAreNoRows: This lane was claimed and gated and then not built, because the shift's remaining time was not enough to build it to the standard PF01 to PF04 were built to. Rows are not written for families that were never built: a STOPPED row asserts a finding about a packet, and there is no finding here. What there is, is an unstarted lane, and this file says so.
whatWasDone: Both families were claimed on the shared claim ledger, and both claims have been RELEASED so another worker can take the lane without a ledger repair.
Both row gates were run and both passed: ky_felony_vacatur_expungement-set binds 2/2 sources by exact SHA-256, sc_17_22_950_summary-set binds 1/1. Neither family is blocked on sources.

Both forms of the Kentucky family were probed. AOC-496.3 is the application and AOC-496.4 is the ORDER, and both name their widgets with bare ordinals, so every caption has to be read off the page at the widget's own coordinates. Between them they carry about 160 widgets and the family also names two composed components.
The South Carolina family's single form, SCCA-223E, sits under 05_SOURCE_GATED in the corpus. It binds by SHA-256, but the gating is worth a look before the family is built.
whyNotStartedAnyway: The shift cut-off is 2026-09-01T15:44:06Z and this decision was taken with under an hour left. Every family in this worker's four completed lanes needed two to four correction rounds after its first render -- a mis-ordered signature block, a caption-mode refusal, a counter measuring binary as ink -- and none of those was visible until the first build ran. Starting a 160-widget family into that margin would most likely have ended the shift with a half-built packet in the tree, which the lane prompt names as worse than one that was never started.
recommendedNextStep: Dispatch PF05 to a fresh worker with a full shift. The two forms are ordinal-named like the Vermont set, so the pattern this worker used there -- an explicit policy table keyed by widget, captions read out of the pinned binary, and the order filled in caption mode only -- transfers directly.
